name: Fake Profile
description: Camila meets her Prince Charming through a dating app. After an idyllic romance, she plans to surprise him — only to end up trapped in a false paradise.

videos.title: Flesh and Bone
videos.overview: Camila is swept off her feet by handsome Fernando. After a dreamy night out, they end up at his hotel suite... unaware they're being watched.

videos.title: Panic in Paradise
videos.overview: A misunderstanding allows for Camila and David to move into Riviera Esmeralda. Pedro tests Miguel. Camila is hell-bent on uncovering the truth.

videos.title: Even If It Hurts
videos.overview: Camila is furious after finding out what's making the rounds online. David questions her desire to stay. A question from Lucas catches her off guard.

videos.title: Breathless
videos.overview: Ángela extracts a promise from Lucas, but what he asks in return startles her. Pedro tells Tina that Miguel has taken the bait. Camila acts dismissively.

videos.title: Dangerous Images
videos.overview: The incident at Camila's home triggers vivid flashbacks for her. Lucas warns Ángela about what the police might find. Pedro calls a meeting.

videos.title: Red Velvet's Secret
videos.overview: Ángela makes a decision about her marriage. Visions of Inti haunt Adrián. One of Miguel's past lovers shares intimate details of their relationship.

videos.title: Inside the Wolf's Mouth
videos.overview: Someone surprising comes to Camila's defense. Inti's seduction attempts persist. Camila leaves a party alone — and puts herself in imminent danger.

videos.title: Temptation in the Dark
videos.overview: Ángela becomes increasingly cynical. Camila receives a word of caution from an unlikely character. Cris spices things up with Adrián.

videos.title: Night of the Executioners
videos.overview: Camila refuses to attend an event and is promptly reminded of what's at stake if she doesn't. What Pedro discovers provokes a hellish response.

videos.title: Don't Say Anything
videos.overview: An accident leaves the community mourning. Something unthinkable comes to light as a visit to Ángela culminates in a calamitous scene.

videos.title: The Forbidden Dream
videos.overview: Ahead of her wedding to David, Camila finds herself haunted by memories of Miguel. Ángela's celebration of her newfound freedom is short-lived.

videos.title: Losing Control
videos.overview: Camila reminisces about the past and resists temptation as Miguel preys on her emotions. Sparks fly during Laura's first date. Ángela points fingers.

videos.title: Anatomy of an Obsession
videos.overview: As the killings rattle Riviera Esmerelda, Miguel tries to make amends with his kids. David proposes a chilling theory. Detective Indira questions Inti.

videos.title: The Man That Never Was
videos.overview: With her marriage to David on the rocks, Camila takes out a restraining order against Miguel. Indira uncovers a common thread between the murders.

videos.title: Pleasure's Edge
videos.overview: In Mexico, Camila mixes business with pleasure. Miguel takes his meddling to the next level. Laura and Matteo grow closer despite her son's disapproval.

videos.title: The Girl Who Knew Too Much
videos.overview: Passion and betrayal collide when Camila gets a deceiving invitation. Ángela reasserts her control of the company. For Inti, freedom comes at a cost.

videos.title: He/She Knows You're Alone
videos.overview: Fueled by her desire for vengeance and reeling from the events of Mexico, Camila returns to Riviera Esmerelda to find Red Velvet — and goes rogue.

videos.title: What Eyes Can't See
videos.overview: Jealousies flare as Camila recovers and new evidence puts Miguel under police scrutiny once more. Inti comes forward with a damning discovery.

videos.title: Death Playing Golf
videos.overview: The hunt for the killer narrows, testing relationships and triggering old wounds. Ángela lashes out. Camila's therapy session takes a harrowing turn.

videos.title: Blood & Hope
videos.overview: True colors come to light as Indira makes a break in the case, Ángela does damage control and Camila learns just how far a master manipulator can go.

videos.title: The Edge of Desire
videos.overview: Camila and Miguel befriend a young couple on their honeymoon, to Miguel's alarm. Indira receives shocking news that'll change everything.

videos.title: Female Survivor
videos.overview: Camila and Miguel attend a different kind of therapy as the Riviera Esmeralda gets a new resident. A new killer targets one of Camila's own.

videos.title: Temptation Knocks at Your Door
videos.overview: Unexpected guests drive a deeper wedge between Miguel and Camila. Eva overhears a private conversation that threatens to disrupt it all.

videos.title: For Fans Only
videos.overview: As temptation sets in, Camila's urges threaten to consume her. Police close in on a murder suspect, as Ángela gets a taste of freedom through pain.

videos.title: Truly Decent People
videos.overview: Rodrigo and Juanita receive a nasty surprise as Camila and Miguel try to repair their marriage. Laura discovers betrayal is closer than she thought.

videos.title: The Man with a Thousand Faces
videos.overview: Miguel unleashes his past – and secrets — to Camila. As another death rocks Riviera Esmeralda, Ángela's trial changes everything. A copycat runs free.

videos.title: This Was Never Love
videos.overview: Doubts cloud Camila's mind as an attack causes a rift at Golden Lips. Inti crashes an intimate gathering, and Vannessa's jealousy becomes a threat.

videos.title: Hidden Urges
videos.overview: Indira makes an arrest in Alberto's death. When a trap goes awry, Camila smells a rat. Miguel's debts and lies catch up to him. Alonso is attacked.

videos.title: Remorse
videos.overview: Inti's obsession resurfaces as Noa meets Ángela. Vannessa bows to pressure, and an innocent party becomes the scene of a devastating disappearance.

videos.title: It's All Fake
videos.overview: The search for Eva continues, and so do Ángela's schemes. An arrest gives Indira a wealth of information, and a special show has a terrible fallout.
